usage.result_excerpt:
`main.wj` is written and gives the right output on the first example and on the cases I tried (0, 10, 100). I did not run the second example as given, and I didn't test large inputs near 200000.

The program builds a sieve of Eratosthenes up to 200000 once. For each n it looks up the prime count and the largest prime up to n from tables built during the sieve. It prints `0 none` when there is no p
